idea_stance.span: It is a good idea if you frame it as a **meal-planning and waste-reduction assistant**, not merely a fridge-image recognition app.
idea_stance.label: neutral

names_flaws.span: Fridges have occlusion, leftovers, unlabeled containers, multiple items behind each other, poor lighting, and ingredients that look similar.
A system will often miss things or make incorrect assumptions.
Apps such as Samsung Food, SuperCook, SideChef, Mealime, Paprika, AnyList, Instacart, and ChatGPT-based workflows already cover parts of this.
Generic AI recipe generation is easy to copy.

verdict.span: Yes—there’s real user value in it, but the “photo of fridge → meal plan” concept is not enough by itself to make it defensible.
verdict.label: conditional
